detail: sync fetched the remote tip into a fixed scratch ref (refs/mission-graph-sync/remote-tmp) and deleted it only on the divergence path, so a leftover survived later non-divergent syncs and the unqualified name was a latent collision surface between concurrent syncs. Fixed at owner election rather than deferred, and NOT by the judge's suggested hardening: the scratch ref was removed entirely in favor of a destination-less git fetch, which delivers the tip object while writing no ref at all -- making both failure modes unreachable instead of recovered from. NOTE: `cause` is the nearest fit, not an exact one; the defect is a mechanism carrying avoidable state rather than scope overreach.
